issue: RUST-MR — a declaration's name is not a read (trait method signature + fn-pointer type parameter)
note: Pre-fix, both shapes published a `uses` edge for a name that only declares. The trait method case produced a SELF-EDGE (`uses current_dir -> current_dir`) whenever the name also resolved. Controls: the impl's DEFINITION of the same method and a real parameter reading a file const both keep publishing, so the guards cannot pass by suppressing reads wholesale. SHAPE 2b (added after the full-extent run): a trait method SIGNATURE's parameter declares too — `collectFunctionBindings` collects `function_item` only, so a bodiless signature has no bound-name set and its parameter names reached the read sweep (cargo/src/compiler/mod.rs:142-143, found at full extent over 2,598 files and not by the 550-file sample).
